title: Vane
subtitle: Pirate
description: Vane, a callous Nikto pirate working for the Pirate King, Gorian Shard, found trouble on Nevarro when he wanted to drink in his favorite bar. Unfortunately, in Greef Karga's transformation of the planet, the bar had become a school. Prone to pick fights, Vane didn't hesitate to draw his pistol against Karga and the Mandalorian, but they killed his comrades and sent him packaging.
